title: Context-intelligence Unit A2: incremental change classification, invalidation closure, incremental/full byte-identical parity (D-013)
objective: Implement D-013 Unit A2 on top of accepted A1: exact change-set derivation (added/content-modified/metadata-modified/deleted/renamed + parser/config/schema invalidations + deterministically affected importers), smallest proven invalidation closure, rename rebinding, full-rebuild-on-global-invalidator with reported reason, corruption/stale-lock/concurrent-writer detection with tested fail-closed rules, idempotent retries, and the enforced BYTE-IDENTICAL incremental-vs-clean-full parity invariant (owner decision 6) with the benchmark scenario matrix (no-change/one-file/dependency/delete/rename/parser-version/config/corrupt-cache/interrupted-write/concurrent-writer, cold+warm). Implemented as: the snapshot fingerprint always hashes content (mtime never trusted); an unchanged snapshot reuses the validated cached generation (the win = skipping parse/resolve); on a local content edit only the changed files are reparsed (their per-file extraction re-run) while every unchanged file's cached extraction bundle is reused, and the exact generator output is reassembled byte-identically (D-013-R032/R059 selective reparse); a structural change (add/delete/rename, which alters the global resolution index or schema-node set) or a global invalidator forces a full rebuild with a recorded reason (the deterministically-safe closure); an unrecognized generator version falls back to the real builder. The byte-identical incremental-vs-clean-full parity invariant is enforced by test against the REAL code_graph.build_graph (D-013-R037/R079); the affected importer closure is derived from the real import edges.
business_reason: D-013 Unit A2; only after A1 is reviewed and accepted (owner decision 4).

acceptance_scenarios.given: a cached generation for the current snapshot
acceptance_scenarios.when: an incremental build runs on the unchanged snapshot
acceptance_scenarios.then: the validated generation is reused (cache hit, no reparse) and its export is byte-identical to a clean full rebuild

acceptance_scenarios.given: content/add/delete/rename/metadata changes and a global (parser/config/schema/eligibility) invalidator
acceptance_scenarios.then: each is classified exactly (added/content_modified/metadata_modified/deleted/renamed/global_invalidators); a rename is not double-counted as add+delete

for a content-only edit only the changed files are reparsed and unchanged files are reused (no full rebuild); for a structural/invalidator change a full rebuild runs with a recorded reason; the deterministically affected importer closure is computed from real edges; and in every case the export is BYTE-IDENTICAL to a clean full rebuild

acceptance_scenarios.given: a corrupt/incomplete generation, a stale lock, or a concurrent writer
acceptance_scenarios.then: the fail-closed A1 cache rules apply (quarantine + rebuild), retries are idempotent, and no half-index is served

acceptance_scenarios.when: incremental output is compared against a clean full rebuild across every change class
